Name: Sebastian older portraits
Author: ColoredInCrayon
Description:
THIS MOD https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31574 <------- RIGHT HERE EVERYONE

I love this mod from what I've seen so far, and I decided to make some portrait changes for Sebastian because of it. Currently, there are no configuration options, so you're stuck with shirtless beach right now, I may add on to it later. I'm also a beginner when it comes to pixel art, so the drawings aren't the same style as the rest of the game. 

If people seem to like this mod, I may add configuration options for tattoos and/or jewelry (Just don't expect it anytime soon)

 Also, please tell me if the file path is messed up at all, i made a character preset for Skyrim and it broke immediately, I don't want a repeat of that.
